common.fixtureBanner: This screen is built from example data, not collected data. Do not rely on it.

home.title: Which conditions should we use?
home.intro: What you choose here changes the verdicts on the screens that follow. Choosing nothing is fine.
howTo: Pick your own conditions, or those of the people travelling with you. Several at once is fine.
In the place list, read the verdict and what still needs checking.
On a place page, open “See how this verdict was worked out” below the verdict to see how the score was arrived at.
home.conditionsLegend: Your own conditions, or those of the people with you
home.cognitiveOption: Travelling with a child who finds new places hard
home.cognitiveHint: Available only once you have ticked “I travel with a stroller”.
home.minRuleTitle: The verdict follows whichever condition this place fits worst
home.minRule: If you choose more than one condition, the calculation follows the one this place serves worst. That keeps an item that is decisive for one person from being hidden behind another person’s score.
home.statItems: Items we check at each place
home.statNote: A blank field means “not known yet”, never “cannot be used”. This service keeps those two apart everywhere.

places.title: Baekje sites and related places in Gongju and Buyeo
places.sortNote: Ordered by verdict: “You can visit”, then “Check first”, then “No information”, then “Consider another place”. “Consider another place” means one required item was confirmed unusable; “No information” means we cannot say anything yet. Confirmed bad news sits at the bottom, which is why those two are in that order. Within the same verdict: fewest per-condition “No information”, then fewest “Check first”, then most of the required items checked.
places.needCheck: No information — check before you go
places.noVerdict: Of the {total} items this verdict is judged on, {unknown} are unknown.
places.noVerdictNothingApplies: None of the items this condition is judged on exists at a place of this kind. Nothing is unchecked — there is nothing to check.
places.resultsReady: Calculated the verdict for {count, plural, one {# place} other {# places}}.
places.unknownCount: {count, plural, one {# item with no information} other {# items with no information}}
places.noPlaces: There are no places to show yet.

place.scoreHiddenReason: Not enough information to judge — check on site
place.needCheckItems: No information — check before you go
place.openCalc: See how this verdict was worked out
place.roundingNote: Displayed values are rounded to three decimal places. The score is computed before rounding, so the row totals and the A total can differ in the last digit.
place.freshnessNote: An old check date means we are less sure, not that the place is worse — so it does not reduce the score.
place.whyCautionUnknown: Required items we do not know: {items}
place.whyCautionCoverage: We have checked {known} of the {total} related items
place.axisAllUnknown: Nothing is known about {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} on the {axis} axis
place.etcNotesHint: Source text we could not split into individual accessibility items. It is shown in Korean, exactly as the source wrote it, and does not enter the score.
place.overviewInKorean: This description is published by the Korea Tourism Organization in Korean only, and is shown here as written.
place.reportsDisclaimer: Posted by visitors and not checked by us. Read it apart from “What the verdict rests on” below, and note that none of it enters the verdict.
place.alternativesHint: Places with a better verdict under the same conditions.
place.safetyNote: The distances above are straight lines between two points, not the distance you would walk — at a hill fortress the path is far longer. Where we could not confirm a facility’s coordinates, no distance is shown. None of this enters the verdict: this material cannot settle how close is close enough.
place.crowdNote: Not how busy it is now, but a forecast for the next 30 days. The source publishes neither a unit nor a ceiling, so the 40 and 70 boundaries below are ones we drew from the spread of observed values. It is not a score out of 100.
place.crowdHeading: Expected crowds over the next 30 days
place.noPhotos: No photographs have been collected for this place yet.
place.reportsReady: Loaded {count, plural, one {# report} other {# reports}}.
place.reportsFailed: Reports could not be loaded. That does not mean there are none — it means we cannot check right now.
place.reportFlagFailed: Could not flag this report. Try again in a moment.
place.coverageBasis: related items whose status we know
place.perPersonaIntro: The verdict above follows whichever condition this place suits least. Taken one condition at a time:
place.perPersonaBasisKnown: {known} of {total} items this needs are checked
place.perPersonaBasisNone: The items this condition rests on do not apply at this place.
place.scoreInCalcNote: Computed from the checked items only. Unchecked items are left out, and which items are checked differs from place to place, so this is not a number to compare places by.
place.confidenceBasis: data confidence — coverage and check dates together
place.whyCautionScore: Everything this verdict rests on is checked, but the fit score is {score}, below the 75 needed for “You can visit”.
place.whyCautionPartial: These required items come with a condition: {items}
place.audioDescriptionAbsent: Audio description — a spoken account of what is in front of you, for blind visitors — is not in the list below. This site’s audio tour and the “Audio guide” item below both tell the story of the site and its exhibits, which is a different thing. We have not yet looked into audio description.

report.done: Your report is posted. You can see it on the place page.
afterwards: It is published straight away. Nobody reads it first.
It appears only in the visitor-reports block on the place page, never mixed in with the items the verdict was taken from.
It does not enter the verdict. A report is what a visitor saw, not a fact we checked.
Anyone can flag a post. If an administrator hides one, it is permanently deleted 90 days later.

gapReport.title: Barrier-free information gap report, Gongju and Buyeo
gapReport.asOf: As of {date} · {places} places · KTO barrier-free travel items
gapReport.fillCaption: The three columns add up to that place’s item count.
gapReport.fillNote: The two columns stay apart because merging them would make the council look as if it had improved something every time we fill in a cell ourselves. Only a rise in the “Confirmed by KTO” column means the council itself has done anything.
gapReport.notRegistered: {place} — the place itself is not registered. It has to be registered before any item can be filled in.
gapReport.itemsIntro: Nobody has established the status of the items below from the material we hold. We could not find out whether the facility itself is missing or only the record of it, or why.
gapReport.itemsCaption: KTO barrier-free items whose status nobody has established yet.
gapReport.itemsGroupCritical: Items some condition takes its verdict on
gapReport.itemsGroupOther: Items no verdict rests on, still used on a visit
gapReport.blockedIntro: The items below are confirmed unusable. Where an item merely has no information, checking it finishes the job; here it does not — someone still has to decide on an alternative, or on changing the facility. We have not worked out what either would take.
gapReport.visitorsDelay: The source data arrives about a month late, so the most recent weeks have no figure yet.
gapReport.visitorsUnavailable: The visitor trend has not been collected yet.
gapReport.empty: Nothing to list as an improvement priority.
